name: Jitsi Meet
description: Self-hosted video conferencing platform with screen sharing, chat and recording.

envVars.description: Public URL Jitsi Meet is reached at
Internal password Jicofo uses to authenticate to Prosody
Internal password JVB uses to authenticate to Prosody

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      XMPP_SERVER: "{{serviceName}}-prosody"
      XMPP_DOMAIN: meet.jitsi
      XMPP_AUTH_DOMAIN: auth.meet.jitsi
      PUBLIC_URL: {{env.PUBLIC_URL}}
      JICOFO_AUTH_PASSWORD: {{env.JICOFO_AUTH_PASSWORD}}
      JVB_AUTH_PASSWORD: {{env.JVB_AUTH_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/web:/config
  {{serviceName}}-prosody:
    image: jitsi/prosody:stable-11031
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-prosody
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUBLIC_URL: "https://meet.example.com"
  {{serviceName}}-jicofo:
    image: jitsi/jicofo:stable-11031
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-jicofo
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      XMPP_SERVER: "{{serviceName}}-prosody"
      JICOFO_AUTH_PASSWORD: {{env.JICOFO_AUTH_PASSWORD}}
  {{serviceName}}-jvb:
    image: jitsi/jvb:stable-11031
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-jvb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      XMPP_SERVER: "{{serviceName}}-prosody"
      JVB_AUTH_PASSWORD: {{env.JVB_AUTH_PASSWORD}}
